intro_subtitle: Everything is quiet. Just scattered pieces. Maybe if I put them in order...
outro_subtitle: It wasn't love. It was a cage I helped build. Sever the chains. Let it go.

nodes.text: The café on 4th Street. You laughed so hard you spilled your drink.

moving_in.subtitle: Everything felt effortless back then. Like we'd known each other forever.

late_text.subtitle: Wait... why did I check my phone three times before you even arrived?

nodes.text: 'Where are you? You said you'd be home ten minutes ago.'

moving_in.subtitle: It was just concern. You kept telling yourself that's what love looks like.

nodes.text: Two suitcases by the door. 'We'll never need anyone else,' you said.

the_proposal.subtitle: Us against the world. It sounded romantic when you first said it.

deleted_texts.subtitle: The apartment got smaller every week. Even the air felt watched.

nodes.text: Your phone facedown on the counter. Notifications turned off.

the_proposal.subtitle: You stopped explaining where you were. Easier than starting another fight.

isolated_friends.subtitle: One by one, the group chats went quiet. You didn't notice until they were gone.

nodes.text: 'They don't really care about you like I do. Stop answering them.'

the_proposal.subtitle: When everyone else was gone, your approval was the only light left in the room.

nodes.text: A quiet Sunday morning. A ring box on the kitchen table.

the_argument.subtitle: A promise that everything would finally calm down. That we'd be safe.

fake_apology.subtitle: The ring came the morning after the worst night. Like a receipt for my forgiveness.

nodes.text: 'I only got angry because I love you too much. Don't make me do it again.'

the_argument.subtitle: Somehow, every apology ended with me promising to be better.

locked_door.subtitle: The apologies stopped sounding sorry. They started sounding like warnings.

nodes.text: The bedroom latch clicking from the outside. 'Calm down first.'

the_argument.subtitle: You called it giving me space. I sat against the doorframe until my knees went numb.

nodes.text: The plates by the sink. Silence that lasted three whole days.

broken_mug.subtitle: I finally stopped flinching. That was the night I packed my bag.

nodes.text: Ceramic shards on the tile. You apologized for being in the way.
